verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub README confirm output format choice among markdown, HTML, and structured JSON, and note that API keys can be locked to specific output formats (implying selectable formats per request). However, 'text' and 'frontmatter' formats are never explicitly documented, and a hands-on community report specifically complains that a mode of Firecrawl (daemon mode) 'not being able to return html', showing the format selection isn't uniformly reliable across the product. missing for 10: explicit support for 'text' and 'frontmatter' formats, and resolution of the reported HTML-return limitation in daemon mode.
